purpose: Frozen conservative visible-face selection for CPU-only exact GLB reconstruction; diagnostic only, unapproved.
selectionMethod: Frozen source face IDs from GPU depth winner at 2048x2048, normalZ>0.15, conservative interior-pixel check; no new visibility calculation during reconstruction.
rleFormat: Each [start,count] is a zero-based contiguous run of source triangle IDs; sorted and nonoverlapping.
